Titles.jpn: 地獄先生ぬ～べ～　午前０時ぬ～べ～死す！

Summaries.eng: The youkai clown possessed the students in his class. Students cannot use "demon hands"! How will Nube, who has been cornered by the biggest pinch, fight!
